description: Arrange a 4-piece band from a natural-language prompt. Returns conductor tempo/groove, 4 lanes of note events, lead sheet, and base64 MIDI. Browser/client synthesizes audio via Csound; use thiri-conductor-mcp locally to render WAV.

prompt.description: Musical direction (e.g. '12-second neo-soul band in Eb, Rhodes + analog bass')

name: conduct_band
